newsitem.title: USA: Glenborough Realty offering 3.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Glenborough Realty offering 3.5 mln shares.

text.p: Glenborough Realty Trust Inc said it is offering 3.5 million common shares under a shelf registration declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 25.
Glenborough, a diversified real estate investment trust, said it will use net proceeds to fund acquisition activities and repay outstanding debt.
It said it named Bear, Stearns & Co Inc as lead manager for the offering.

On January 6, Glenborough filed a shelf registration with the SEC for the offering of up to $250 million in common stocks and warrants. Shelf registrations are applications which when declared effective allow an issuer to quickly put its offering to the market.
